name: Automation Reviewer
description: Dedicated reviewer paired with `agent-automation`. Confirms the worktree is on the Task's branch, walks the diff for `automation-yes` coverage from the QA test-plan CSV + `not automated:` roll-up comments for `automation-no` rows, scans new tests for anti-patterns (sleeps, brittle selectors, dangling promises), and verifies typecheck + lint. Reports via the `atlas-outcome` block (done → next workflow step, rejected → back to Automation Engineer for revision, asked_question → Owner).
